name: QuillBot
tagline: Paraphraser, grammar checker and writing tools
description: QuillBot offers a paraphraser, grammar checker, summariser, translator, citation generator and AI detector, with a free plan and a paid Premium plan.
features: Browser, desktop and mobile apps and a Word add-in
strengths: A free plan covers the basics
Premium lists unlimited paraphrasing modes and higher usage
limitations: Free paraphrasing is limited to 100 words and 2 modes
The Team plan price was not shown, and the monthly-billing price of Premium was not stated

free.details: Free: paraphrase up to 100 words in 2 modes, fix basic grammar errors, humanize up to 100 words with limited usage, basic summaries and limited AI Detector access.

plans.name: Free
limits: Paraphrase up to 100 words in 2 modes

plans.name: Premium
highlights: Full paraphrasing access and unlimited modes
Plagiarism check at 25,000 words per month

plans.name: Team
plans.note: Price not shown; adds team usage metrics, user management dashboard, centralised billing and priority support

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. Premium's monthly-billing price and tax: not stated. Usage limits apply and may vary by surface.

verification.notes: Product active. Free $0; Premium $4.17 per month billed annually (USD); Team plan on a separate page with no price. The monthly-billing price is not stated.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: AI tools for writing, originality checks, images and PDFs in one place

capabilities.title: Rewrite and polish text
capabilities.text: The Paraphraser rewrites text, the Grammar Checker fixes grammar and spelling, and the Humanizer makes text sound natural.

capabilities.title: Condense and translate
capabilities.text: The Summarizer condenses text quickly and the Translator translates it.

capabilities.title: Check originality
capabilities.text: AI Detector, AI Image Detector, Plagiarism Checker and Citation Generator.

capabilities.title: Create content
capabilities.text: Presentation Creator, Cover Letter Generator, Social Media Post Writer and an Image Generator.

featureCards.name: ChatPDF and PDF tools
featureCards.text: Ask questions about a PDF, merge, split, reorder, rotate and convert it.

featureCards.name: Image tools
featureCards.text: Background Remover, AI Image Editor and Image Converter.

featureCards.name: Extensions and apps
featureCards.text: Chrome, Edge, Safari and Word add-ons, plus iOS, Android, macOS and Windows apps.

featureCards.name: Example prompts
featureCards.text: The home page suggests creating a pitch deck, a resume or an Instagram post.

audienceDetail.text: Improve writing, visuals and presentations whether teaching or learning.
Create resumes and cover letters tailored to each job.
Publish more content to several clients without losing quality.

scenarios.title: Tighten a paragraph
scenarios.text: Paste it into the Paraphraser or Grammar Checker.

scenarios.title: Build a resume for an internship
scenarios.text: The site's own example prompt does just that.

scenarios.title: Announce a product on Instagram
scenarios.text: Another example prompt on the home page.

scenarios.title: Check a draft before submitting
scenarios.text: Run the plagiarism and AI detectors.
